# bintables/len

> len: a string's length is its first qword; a slice's is at offset 8 of its header.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when x str`

```nasm
{x}
mov rax, [rax]
```

### `emit`

```nasm
{x}
mov rax, [rax+8]
```
